title: The Rate Limiter That Blocks Everyone
description: One customer's requests block unrelated accounts, and requests are rejected after the rolling window should reset.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: RateLimiter(limit, window) requires positive values. allow(key, now) counts accepted requests in (now-window, now], separately per key. Rejecting a request must not extend its window. Timestamps are nondecreasing per key; reject backwards timestamps. C++ uses double seconds and string keys. Python rejects boolean limits.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
